verdict.rationale: Docs show core building blocks for ledger legibility: unlimited per-user/seller wallets, dedicated fee wallets auto-wired monthly, webhook notifications on every API object event (payins, transfers, payouts), and dispute/chargeback tracking with contestable settlement — all of which support traceability from charge through split to payout. However there is no explicit documentation of a consolidated reconciliation report, statement/ledger export, or penny-level balance reconciliation tooling for finance teams, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of accounting accuracy. Missing for 10: dedicated reconciliation/statement export API or report, explicit balance-history/audit-trail endpoint, and third-party validation that ledgers tie out to the penny.
